testcase.name: Scenario: Create a feature while editing a single model-state member: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-model-browser-source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:1658:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Create a feature while editing a single model-state member ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State and activates Copy State ✔ And The MCAD Software has an empty part with Primary, Capture State, and Copy State model states ✔ And Copy State is active and the edit scope is a single member ✔ When the user creates a rectangular sketch and extrudes it as a solid ✔ Then the extrusion is computed in Copy State ✔ And its model-state indicator lists the extrusion as suppressed in Primary and Capture State ✔ When the user shows the solid using All Visible on the active view representation ✔ And activates Primary ✔ Then the solid is absent and the extrusion row is dimmed and struck through ✔ When the user reactivates Copy State ✔ Then the solid is visible and the extrusion row is no longer struck through
